headline: Indian Stock Market Enters Samvat 2083 With Diwali Muhurat Trading Following Strong Weekly Gains

marketStatus.message: Today is Diwali Laxmi Pujan. NSE will conduct Muhurat Trading. Exact trading timings are notified separately by NSE.

why: Strong global cues and domestic buying momentum drove Sensex and Nifty significantly higher earlier in the week.
Indian equities bucked a broader global technology selloff to post their best weekly performance in six years.
Market sentiment remains buoyant as D-Street enters Samvat 2083 with Nifty holding strong technical levels.
Historical data over the past 10 to 20 years shows positive market sentiment during special Diwali Muhurat sessions.
whatHappening: NSE and BSE are holding the special Diwali Muhurat Trading session today to mark Laxmi Pujan.
Sensex settled over 1,700 to 2,000 points higher, crossing the 81,000 mark ahead of Diwali.
Analysts have highlighted top stock picks including ITC and ICICI Bank for the Muhurat trading session.
Global gold prices have fallen 24% from record highs, while domestic gold in India is down 20%.
summary:
Indian stock markets commence Samvat 2083 today with the traditional Diwali Muhurat Trading session.
Ahead of Diwali, benchmark indices Sensex and Nifty 50 posted robust gains, outperforming global peers.
Market participants are closely tracking top recommendations such as ITC and ICICI Bank for today's special session.
